title: Kártya or Készpénz: Paying at the End

sections.title: Explanation
sections.content: Kártya (card) and készpénz (cash) are the two payment options; asking Kártya vagy készpénz? is how a waiter checks how you'll pay.
Fizetek (I'm paying/I pay) uses the same regular verb pattern as Unit 21's fizet — no ik-verb ending needed.
